AttributeList.Text: Tank heat and stage requests with burner RUN and lockout supervision. Flame safety belongs to the burner control box.
One-scan pulse on a new press; ignored on first scan or while STOP is pressed. Reference: R-05.
Detect a new START press
Save the current button state for detecting a new press on the next scan. Reference: R-05.
Remember the START button state
Compare the selector with its previous state; either direction counts as a change. Reference: R-02.
Detect an AUTO/MAN change
Save the selected mode for the next scan. Reference: R-02.
Remember the AUTO/MAN selector
Detect either change of the fuel input; BR01 has a fixed FALSE input. Reference: R-12.
Detect a fuel selector change
Save the current fuel input for the next scan; this does not select fuel valves. Reference: R-12.
Remember the fuel selector
Reading must be -20.0 to 150.0 degC inclusive; raw values are tenths of a degree. Reference: C07d / C08d.
Check temperature sensor A
Apply the same limits independently to sensor B; one valid sensor is not enough. Reference: C07d / C08d.
Check temperature sensor B
Both checks must pass before heat is permitted. Reference: C07d / C08d.
Check that both temperatures are valid
The startup window ends after 10 seconds; this bit alone does not confirm valid sensors. Reference: R-10.
Time the temperature startup window
Timer runs while either temperature reading is invalid. Reference: C07d / C08d / R-10.
Time an invalid temperature reading
After the startup window, an invalid reading faults immediately; startup invalidity also faults after 10 seconds. Reference: C07d / C08d / R-10.
Raise a temperature fault
Copy A when A is at least B; heat permission is checked separately. Reference: C07b / C08b.
Use sensor A as the higher temperature
Copy B when it exceeds A; this is the control temperature, not a new physical sensor. Reference: C07b / C08b.
Use sensor B as the higher temperature
Restart limit = stop setting - restart difference. Stage 2 ON limit = stop setting - stage 2 offset. Reference: C07b / C08b / C07c / C08c.
Calculate the restart and stage 2 limits
Stage 2 OFF limit = its ON limit + 2.0 degC; raw addition is 20. Reference: C07c / C08c.
Calculate the stage 2 OFF limit
Set the temperature demand at or below the restart limit; keep it until the stop limit. Reference: C07b / C08b.
AUTO: request heat at the restart limit
Clear demand at or above the stop setting, or if either temperature is invalid. Reference: C07b / C08b.
AUTO: clear heat demand at the stop limit
AUTO uses the retained temperature demand; MAN needs a valid temperature below the stop setting. Reference: B-01.
Determine whether heat is needed
Need tank level OK, both temperatures valid, E-STOP reset, no burner lockout, no daily pause and no scrubber trip. Reference: C07a / C08a / C07d / C08d / C01 / C07e / C08e / C07h / C03 / C05.
Check all burner start conditions
When enabled for this burner, 24 hours of continuous heat request sets the pause. Reference: C07h / R-08.
Request the daily burner stop
Clear the daily pause after RUN feedback stays OFF for 60 seconds. Reference: R-08.
End the daily stop after RUN is off
RUN feedback with no heat request for 30 seconds sets a fault condition. Reference: R-09.
Detect RUN without a heat request
While STARTING, time the maximum wait for RUN using the accepted start-time setting. Reference: C07f / C08f.
Check the burner start timeout
Need a new press, IDLE and all start conditions. AUTO may wait for heat; MAN must already need heat. Reference: R-01 / B-01.
Accept START permission
STOP, AUTO/MAN change, fuel change or scrubber trip cancels the permission, including AUTO waiting for heat. Reference: B-01 / R-02 / R-12 / R-13.
Cancel START permission
Move from IDLE to STARTING only with permission, healthy conditions, heat demand and RUN initially OFF. Reference: B-01 / R-09.
Begin the burner start sequence
While STARTING, RUN feedback changes the state to RUNNING. Reference: B-01.
Accept the burner RUN feedback
With E-STOP healthy, a scrubber trip while STARTING or RUNNING records this fault. Reference: C03 / C05 / R-13.
Fault on a scrubber trip during operation
While starting or running, return to IDLE if start conditions, heat demand or START permission are lost. Reference: C07a / C08a / C07b / C08b / C07h / B-01.
Return to IDLE when heating must stop
In MAN, returning to IDLE after a heat request cancels the previous START permission. Reference: R-03.
MAN: require START after each cycle
If still STARTING when the start timer expires, record the start fault. Reference: C07f / C08f.
Fault if RUN does not arrive in time
In RUNNING, loss of RUN without lockout records this fault, unless an earlier stop already changed the state. Reference: C07g / C08g.
Fault if RUN feedback is lost
FAULT cancels START permission before reset handling; this prevents restart from an old START. Reference: B-02.
Cancel START before resetting a fault
Need FAULT, a new RESET, healthy E-STOP and temperatures, no lockout or scrubber trip, and RUN OFF. A new START is still needed. Reference: R-06 / R-07.
Reset burner faults after recovery
Loss of the common E-STOP permission sets FAULT and remembers the emergency-stop cause. Reference: C01.
Record the emergency-stop fault
The lockout input sets FAULT; resetting the certified burner box is a separate local action. Reference: C07e / C08e.
Record the burner control-box lockout
An active temperature-fault condition sets FAULT and remembers the cause. Reference: C07d / C08d.
Record the temperature sensor fault
After the 30-second condition is met, set FAULT and remember the RUN mismatch. Reference: R-09.
Record RUN without a request
Heat request is ON in STARTING or RUNNING. The certified burner box controls purge, ignition and flame safety. Reference: E1 / E3.
Send the burner heat request
Only in RUNNING and below the calculated ON limit. Example: stop 70, offset 10 means ON below 60 degC. Reference: C07c / C08c.
Request stage 2 below its ON temperature
Clear stage 2 at or above its OFF limit, or outside RUNNING. In the example, OFF at 62 degC. Reference: C07c / C08c.
Cancel stage 2 at its OFF temperature
Burner
